answer_1.quote: UniDebugger is an end-to-end framework for unified debugging through LLM-based multi-agent synergy.
answer_1.outputs: The framework generates patches or fixed code snippets in 'diff' format for software bugs.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the APR metrics, specifically focusing on the number of bugs that are plausibly or correctly fixed.

answer_4.quote: The patch will be sent to developers for manual correctness verification if passing all test cases.
answer_4.guideline: Developers manually verify the correctness of patches that pass all test cases.
